title: Many Lives Totem
description: a totem of undying  that can be used 5 times, and has the same effects as a normal totem
body: The Many Lives Totem is an enhanced version of the vanilla Totem of Undying that can save your life up to 5 times before breaking, making it a valuable long-term survival tool. When held in your main hand or off-hand, it will automatically activate upon fatal damage, restoring your health to 1 and granting the same beneficial effects as a regular totem (Regeneration II, Absorption II, and Fire Resistance). You can right-click the totem at any time to check how many uses remain, and the tooltip will show color-coded durability information - green for excellent condition, yellow for moderate wear, and red when you're down to your final use
